enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Breathes slowly. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up. Turns to right side. Adjusts pillow. Remains still. Breathes deeply. Turns onto back. Stretches arms. Remains asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wakes up. Sits up in bed. Stands up. Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on tap. Wet face. Applies soap. Rinses face. Turns off tap. Dries face with towel. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Spits. Turns off light. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, drinking coffee
enriched_activities.desc: Enters kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out eggs and milk. Closes refrigerator. Opens cupboard. Takes out bowl. Cracks eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turns on induction cooker. Places pan on cooker. Pours oil. Pours eggs into pan. Scrambles eggs. Turns off cooker. Places eggs on plate. Toasts bread. Makes coffee. Sits at table. Eats breakfast. Drinks coffee.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and reviewing shift notes on phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Opens wardrobe. Takes out shirt. Takes out pants. Closes wardrobe. Lays clothes on bed. Removes pajamas. Puts on shirt. Puts on pants. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Picks up phone. Unlocks phone. Opens notes app. Reads shift notes. Scrolls through notes. Closes notes app. Locks phone. Picks up bag. Walks out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to car. Unlocks car. Opens car door. Sits in driver's seat. Closes door. Fastens seatbelt. Inserts key. Starts engine. Checks rearview mirror. Drives forward. Stops at red light. Continues driving. Parks car in hospital parking lot. Turns off engine. Unfastens seatbelt. Opens door. Gets out. Closes door. Locks car. Walks to hospital entrance.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional: patient assessments, medication rounds and clinical documentation
enriched_activities.desc: Enters hospital. Changes into scrubs. Goes to nurses' station. Reviews patient list. Walks to patient room. Knocks. Enters. Greets patient. Checks vital signs. Administers medication. Documents in chart. Moves to next patient. Repeats assessments. Administers medications. Documents. Continues patient care. Returns to nurses' station. Updates charts. Attends handover meeting. Takes notes.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at the hospital
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to cafeteria. Stands in line. Selects food. Pays for food. Carries tray to table. Sits down. Eats food. Drinks water. Checks phone. Finishes meal. Returns tray. Walks back to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional: continuing patient care, handover preparation and charting
enriched_activities.desc: Continues patient care. Checks on patients. Administers medications. Updates charts. Prepares handover report. Reviews patient notes. Communicates with colleagues. Writes in patient records. Uses computer for charting. Prints handover documents. Organizes paperwork. Attends handover meeting. Presents patient status. Listens to feedback. Updates handover notes. Files documents. Organizes desk. Prepares to leave. Says goodbye to colleagues. Walks to exit.

Walks to car. Unlocks car. Opens door. Sits in driver's seat. Closes door. Fastens seatbelt. Starts engine. Drives out of parking lot. Stops at traffic light. Continues driving. Parks car at home. Turns off engine. Unfastens seatbelt. Opens door. Gets out. Closes door. Locks car. Walks to front door. Unlocks front door. Enters house.

Enters kitchen. Washes hands. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables and meat. Closes refrigerator. Opens cupboard. Takes out cutting board and knife. Chops vegetables. Cuts meat. Turns on induction cooker. Places pan on cooker. Pours oil. Adds vegetables and meat. Stirs. Adds spices. Turns off cooker. Places food on plate. Sits at table. Eats dinner. Clears dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and washing up after the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bathroom. Turns on water heater. Removes clothes. Places clothes in hamper. Steps into shower. Turns on shower. Wets body. Applies soap. Washes body. Rinses body. Applies shampoo. Washes hair. Rinses hair. Turns off shower. Steps out of shower. Picks up towel. Dries body. Dries hair. Wraps towel around body. Walks to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote control. Turns on TV. Changes channel. Watches TV. Continues watching TV. Changes channel again. Gets up. Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out drink. Closes refrigerator. Walks back to living room. Sits on sofa. Drinks. Watches TV. Turns off TV. Stands up. Walks to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer to check emails and read before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Sits at desk. Opens laptop. Turns on laptop. Enters password. Opens email client. Checks emails. Reads emails. Replies to email. Closes email client. Opens web browser. Reads news. Opens e-book reader. Reads book. Closes e-book reader. Closes laptop. Turns off desk lamp. Stands up. Walks to bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Night routine: brushing teeth and washing up
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bathroom. Turns on light and tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Spits. Washes face. Turns off tap. Dries face. Turns off light. Walks out.
Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Breathes slowly. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket. Turns to right side. Adjusts pillow. Remains still. Breathes deeply. Turns onto back. Stretches arms. Remains asleep.
